component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.letters.schema
component.documentation:
The letters' model, on the platform's Template Rendering:
- Correspondence (correspondence, corr:), on a kit's record type: letters may be written on a record of the type, in its corr:language when a template exists in it. - LetterTemplate, the platform's TemplateSource with the add-on's facet of the same name (letter_template, ltpl:): which letter it is a template of, its language, and the conditions the record must meet. The platform's tmpl:applicableTypes names the record types it is for, and tmpl:templateType the add-on's processor, agenticLetter. Kept by administrators alone. - Letter, a letter as the add-on files it next to its record (letter, letter:), with the platform's TemplateBased facet, which binds it to the template it was written from. Written by the server alone.
